results.title: Nifty at risk below 24,000; MCX, Havells among stocks to watch next week: Rupak De
results.description: Nifty faces a crucial 24,000 support level after weakening momentum, with a break potentially triggering short-term bearishness. Analyst Rupak De favours auto and PSU banks, while highlighting MCX, ELGI Equipments, Havells and Himadri Speciality Chemical as trading opportunities.
